description: This Java source file implements an Android IntentService that listens for geofence transition events, handles connection to GoogleApiClient, and communicates geofence status to other components (like a wearable device) via DataApi.

classes.name: GeofenceTransitionsIntentService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles geofence transition events, manages GoogleApiClient connection, and updates data items for geofence entries and exits.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes GoogleApiClient with Wearable API and sets up connection callback handlers.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Processes the incoming intent to handle geofence transition events. Sends data to wearable when entering geofence and deletes data when exiting.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message on the main thread informing the user about geofence transitions.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Callback invoked when GoogleApiClient successfully connects; currently no additional actions.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection is suspended; currently no additional actions.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when the connection attempt fails; currently no additional actions.
